original_reviewer_record.judgment: Accept the local editorial workspace with a narrow-table discoverability reservation.

strengths: Original pixels show an intentional paper/editorial direction: warm surrounding material, white paper, red margin, serif reading hierarchy, subdued tags, and a differentiated ruled monospaced editor. Long English and Chinese remain readable in light and dark.

Native edit of an English and a Chinese addition survived reload and appeared in a real tiddler file. Confirmed discard removed the draft; related-note ledger navigation, search result activation and reaching another editor by keyboard worked.
The narrow ledger scrolls horizontally within its table while the document remains 390px wide; wheel inspection exposed the complete rightmost evidence-boundary column.
defects: The narrow ledger initially clips columns without an obvious visible scroll hint. The table itself has no explicit tabindex/region label in the inspected DOM, unlike P12's wrapper.
Sticky titles reduce the reading area and can sit over the first visible text line during deep scrolling; the sidebar is intentionally hidden on narrow screens.
unknowns: Keyboard horizontal table scrolling and full server-failure recovery were not exercised. Theme source and MIT notice were inspected, but producer candidate-research process was withheld.
